name: index_momentum_v1
mechanism: NIFTY experiences sharp 1-minute directional bursts when macro news hits or algorithmic momentum strategies trigger cascading entries via TWAP/VWAP algorithms working large directional orders. These bursts exhibit autocorrelation at the 30-60 second scale because institutional orders are typically only 40-60% filled in the first 12-bar (1-min) window, leaving residual order flow that sustains the move. When both the 5-minute trend (ret_60) and the 1-minute acceleration (ret_12) confirm the same direction, we are entering during active institutional order completion rather than at the exhaustion of a move.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute trend confirmed by 1-minute acceleration alignment for institutional order completion continuation
